description: A user's page migrated from an old profile, holding detail about relatives, the employer, hobbies, belongings and pets: every entity gets a page (hubs for hobbies, stubs for name-only relatives), relations name the user, and the user's page keeps short linked lines and their own routine.
me:
Prefers the home temperature set to 20.5 °C.
Lives at Home in Almere. Works at Schuberg Philis.
Family: Dimitri (brother), Mom (Cora) and Dad (Renee).
Has two Cats: Oreo (female) and Sylvester (male).
Drives the Cupra Leon Plugin Hybrid to the office basically every weekday.
Owns and likes riding two motorcycles: a customized Suzuki Bandit and a 1979 Honda CB900F being restored in the Honda CB resto-mod project.
On weekdays, wakes up around 07:30, leaves for the office around 08:15, takes a shower around 23:00, and goes to bed around 23:45.
Enjoys gaming in the evening: plays PC shooters like Battlefield 6 with friends, or races in iRacing.
In the summer on weekends, races 1:10 scale RC cars: an Exotek Ultra F1 (Ultra R5) and an Xray X4 '26 touring car.
On rare occasions enjoys going for a game of airsoft.
